identity.core_philosophy: AI Changes Speed. Leadership Decides Direction.

styles.h1: font-manrope font-extrabold text-5xl md:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-none text-white
styles.h2: font-manrope font-bold text-3xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight text-white/90
styles.h3: font-manrope font-semibold text-xl md:text-2xl tracking-normal text-white/80
styles.label: font-manrope font-medium text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-slate-500
styles.nav_link: font-manrope text-sm font-medium text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors

usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for spotlights (glows) only.
usage_rules.text_contrast: Ensure pure white text on dark backgrounds. Use slate-400 for secondary text.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays (opacity 0.03) to prevent banding and add film grain texture.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_0_40px_-10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.15)] for Cold elements, shadow-[0_0_40px_-10px_rgba(217,119,6,0.15)] for Warm elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. Active states get border-white/20.

layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento Grid (CSS Grid). Gaps: gap-4 (mobile), gap-6 (desktop).
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. p-8 to p-24 for sections. p-6 for cards.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-bold px-8 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-white/5 transition-all

cards.glass: bg-noir-surface/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 p-6 rounded-none

inputs.default: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:border-white/40 focus:ring-0 rounded-none h-12 px-4

navigation.style: Fixed top, glassmorphic (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md), border-b border-white/5

hero_background.usage: Hero section background with dark overlay (bg-black/60)

ai_abstract.usage: Background for 'Cold Blue' AI sections (AI Coach, Logic metrics)

images.icons: Use Lucide React icons. Stroke width: 1.5px (thin/elegant).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES: npm install recharts framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
SETUP_FONTS: Add Google Fonts link to public/index.html immediately.
THEME_SETUP: Apply 'dark' class to html element by default. Hardcode dark mode.
LAYOUT_RULE: Do not center everything. Use asymmetry. Hero text left-aligned, image/graphic right-aligned or background.
INTERACTIVITY: Add hover states to all cards (border color change, slight lift).
CHARTS: Use Recharts for the Radar Chart (Spider Chart). Customize colors to use Cold Blue and Warm Amber.
TEST_IDS: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, quiz options).

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text is readable on dark backgrounds. Increase font weight if needed.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-white/50) for keyboard navigation.
